company.name: Duna
company.shortDescription: Duna is an AI-native business onboarding platform for regulated companies such as banks, fintechs, and financial institutions.
company.description: Duna is an AI-native business identity platform built for banks, fintechs, marketplaces, and other regulated businesses. It streamlines customer onboarding, KYC, KYB, AML, and ongoing compliance through automated workflows, intelligent identity verification, and policy-driven decision making. By combining AI with a unified data platform and low-code tools, Duna helps organizations reduce manual reviews, improve onboarding speed, strengthen fraud prevention, and maintain regulatory compliance throughout the customer lifecycle.
